Overview.Name: Srinivas Gandla
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed, avoids non-veg on Monday, Saturday, Sunday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs ) + small bowl curd
Option 2: Paneer cubes (120 g) pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - controlled): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2–3 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with protein before eating rice to improve sugar control.
Avoid sweets and late-night eating as it worsens diabetes and thyroid balance.
Follow vegetarian options on Monday, Saturday and Sunday.
Maintain fixed meal timing daily for better metabolic control.
For cravings, drink buttermilk and wait 10 minutes before eating anything extra.
